scaled_linear_motion_segmentation.description: Reduced deterministic Split4D rendered-feature benchmark corresponding to the paper's dynamic multi-view setting. These values are the accepted scaled gym baseline from job 6eb37562-eec; full-scale paper numbers are recorded separately under paper_fullscale_* experiments.
scaled_linear_motion_segmentation.notes: This is a deliberate scaled replacement for the paper's full Neural3DV/Multi-Human/SelfCap datasets. It is included so future agents can compare against the reproducible reduced benchmark; paper-reported values remain in the paper_fullscale_* groups.

mIoU.description: Mean instance IoU on the evaluated split primitives.

mAcc.description: Mean one-vs-rest instance accuracy on the evaluated split primitives.

Recall.description: Mean instance recall across all objects.

F1.description: Mean instance F1 score, balancing precision and recall.

Recalldyn.description: Recall averaged over objects identified as dynamically moving.

Recallstatic.description: Recall averaged over slower/static objects to catch dynamic-only tuning.

ClusterSizeError.description: Mean normalized absolute difference between aligned predicted cluster sizes and true instance sizes, catching cluster imbalance without saturating on correct cluster counts.

MaskFeatureAgreement.description: Mean same-mask feature margin over complementary observation slices, catching label-only shortcuts that do not learn coherent rendered features.

TrackingFeatureMargin.description: Mean positive-minus-hardest-negative feature cosine margin over geometry-matched adjacent-time primitive pairs, catching temporally inconsistent or non-discriminative feature artifacts.

scaled_streaming_ablation.description: Reduced deterministic interaction-motion ablation: ordered-observation feature learning versus the same learner with random temporal sampling.
scaled_streaming_ablation.notes: This is a deliberate scaled replacement for the paper's full Multi-Human Juggle ablation. It is included so future agents can compare against the reproducible reduced benchmark; paper-reported values remain in the paper_fullscale_streaming_ablation group.
